integrity: All necessary proof and standalone finite diagnostic checker included; numerical checks support but do not replace the analytical weak-limit argument.
scientific_limitations: Unitary positive two-periodic nearest-neighbour walk, initial state supported on the two sites of one cell, weak ballistic limit only; no finite-time local asymptotic or general states. A broad 2022 pushforward theorem already implies an integral representation, and independent prior-art review remains absent.
title: A coherence-tilted arcsine law for a two-periodic quantum walk
